title: Кто проедет первым?
adaptation: Same approaches and maneuvers; vehicles recoloured red, blue, yellow.
visuals: Deterministic Godot 3D; canonical road-sign faces; no generated imagery.
changes: Bright white model base and pale sky; matte surfaces preserve soft shadows.
Sign glyphs cropped to their true alpha bounds, centred at one height and reduced to a shared 2.8 m maximum visible extent.
Straight manoeuvre hints end before the intersection and do not overlap the curved hint.
Imported lamp assets replaced by twelve vertical procedural poles with orthogonal road-facing consoles.
Existing narration, caption timing, baseline alignment and clean ending retained.

preservationCheck.mediaPolicy: Published pilot and intermediate media removed at owner request; source, recipe, text and timings kept.
